answer_sql:
WITH anchor AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(MAX(order_date) AS DATE) AS as_of
  FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(s.open_date AS DATE), a.as_of) / 365.25), 2) AS average_age_years
FROM contoso_served.dim_store AS s
CROSS JOIN anchor AS a
WHERE
  s.location_code <> -1 AND s.close_date IS NULL
